name: com.lingkyn.xr-ui-shell.ui-toolkit
displayName: Lingkyn XR UI Shell UI Toolkit
description: Thin UI Toolkit sibling adapter for the Lingkyn XR UI Shell Core: fail-closed binding of each declared panel to exactly one world-space UIDocument with a collider in an admitted update mode and (for a wrist- or hand-admitting panel) an anchor transform, each an explicit reference with a stable diagnostic when missing; one injectable ScriptableObject skin seam mapping the shared design-language tokens to the closed shell-slot set as USS-facing values, with a default skin carrying the canonical values; translation of accepted routing results to the bound document only; and a plain runtime constructed with explicit references that applies accepted placement intents to the bound document subtrees. Shares nothing with the UGUI sibling adapter except the Core.
